001package org.clafer.choco.constraint.propagator;
002
003import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.Propagator;
004import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.PropagatorPriority;
005import org.chocosolver.solver.exception.ContradictionException;
006import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.BoolVar;
007import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.IntVar;
008import org.chocosolver.util.ESat;
009
010/**
011 *
012 * @author jimmy
013 */
014public class PropTernary extends Propagator<IntVar> {
015
016    private final BoolVar antecedent;
017    private final IntVar result, consequent, alternative;
018
019    public PropTernary(BoolVar antecedent, IntVar result, IntVar consequent, IntVar alternative) {
020        super(new IntVar[]{antecedent, result, consequent, alternative}, PropagatorPriority.BINARY, false);
021        this.antecedent = antecedent;
022        this.result = result;
023        this.consequent = consequent;
024        this.alternative = alternative;
025    }
026
027    @Override
028    public void propagate(int evtmask) throws ContradictionException {
029        if (!antecedent.isInstantiated()) {
030            int ub = result.getUB();
031            boolean intersects1 = false;
032            boolean intersects2 = false;
033            for (int i = result.getLB(); i <= ub; i = result.nextValue(i)) {
034                boolean contains1 = consequent.contains(i);
035                boolean contains2 = alternative.contains(i);
036                intersects1 |= contains1;
037                intersects2 |= contains2;
038                if (!contains1 && !contains2) {
039                    result.removeValue(i, this);
040                }
041            }
042            assert intersects1 || intersects2;
043            if (!intersects1) {
044                antecedent.setToFalse(this);
045            } else if (!intersects2) {
046                antecedent.setToTrue(this);
047            }
048        }
049        if (antecedent.isInstantiated()) {
050            if (antecedent.getValue() == 1) {
051                PropUtil.domSubsetDom(result, consequent, this);
052                PropUtil.domSubsetDom(consequent, result, this);
053            } else {
054                PropUtil.domSubsetDom(result, alternative, this);
055                PropUtil.domSubsetDom(alternative, result, this);
056            }
057        }
058    }
059
060    @Override
061    public ESat isEntailed() {
062        if (antecedent.isInstantiated()) {
063            if (antecedent.getValue() == 1) {
064                return PropUtil.isDomIntersectDom(result, consequent)
065                        ? (result.isInstantiated() && consequent.isInstantiated() ? ESat.TRUE : ESat.UNDEFINED)
066                        : ESat.FALSE;
067            } else {
068                return PropUtil.isDomIntersectDom(result, alternative)
069                        ? (result.isInstantiated() && alternative.isInstantiated() ? ESat.TRUE : ESat.UNDEFINED)
070                        : ESat.FALSE;
071            }
072        }
073        return PropUtil.isDomIntersectDom(result, consequent) || PropUtil.isDomIntersectDom(result, alternative)
074                ? ESat.UNDEFINED : ESat.FALSE;
075    }
076
077    @Override
078    public String toString() {
079        return result + " = " + antecedent + " ? " + consequent + " : " + alternative;
080    }
081}
